description: This file contains utility functions and classes for image processing, including image reading, preprocessing, transformation adjustments, resizing, and visual effects, used within an object detection framework.

classes.name: TransformParameters
classes.description: A class encapsulating parameters for image transformation, including border mode and interpolation settings.

classes.name: VisualEffect
classes.description: A class representing visual effects parameters for image color adjustments, including contrast, brightness, hue, and saturation modifications.

methods.name: read_image_bgr
methods.description: Reads an image from a file path and returns it in BGR format.

methods.name: preprocess_image
methods.description: Preprocesses an image by subtracting the ImageNet mean, with modes for 'caffe' and 'tf'.

methods.name: adjust_transform_for_image
methods.description: Adjusts a transformation matrix for a specific image, scaling translation and centering the origin.

methods.name: apply_transform
methods.description: Applies an affine transformation to an image using a transformation matrix and parameters.

methods.name: compute_resize_scale
methods.description: Calculates a scale factor to resize an image within specified min and max side constraints.

methods.name: resize_image
methods.description: Resizes an image to fit within specified min and max side lengths.

methods.name: random_visual_effect_generator
methods.description: Generates random visual effect parameters within specified ranges for contrast, brightness, hue, and saturation.

methods.name: adjust_contrast
methods.description: Adjusts the contrast of an image by a given factor.

methods.name: adjust_brightness
methods.description: Adjusts the brightness of an image by adding a delta value.

methods.name: adjust_hue
methods.description: Adjusts the hue of an image by a delta value.

methods.name: adjust_saturation
methods.description: Adjusts the saturation of an image by a given factor.
